subject.title: feat(ledger): add immutable action history core

question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this immutable ledger schema, privacy contract, and fail-closed filesystem trust model as the durable foundation for later workflow instrumentation?
rationale: The PR creates a permanent automation, stored-data, and security boundary whose compatibility, privacy, retention, and portability choices cannot be settled by test results alone.

options.title: Approve the core contract
options.body: Accept the schema and trust model after the pending check completes, then review the stacked instrumentation against this frozen contract.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land only the event model and local immutable spool while deferring shard import, remote projection, or the broad filesystem helper surface.

options.title: Pause the ledger direction
options.body: Keep current mutable projections authoritative until maintainers choose a different durable-audit architecture.

recommendation.title: Approve the core contract
recommendation.body: Accept the schema and trust model after the pending check completes, then review the stacked instrumentation against this frozen contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available adjacent history spans durable state, serialization, dashboard, and workflow architecture, making this the best routing candidate for the permanent contract decision.
